name: Spanish Common Words Set 36
description: This set is part of a larger collection of common Spanish words to help learners build their vocabulary.

cards.sentence: Decidió abandonar su trabajo para viajar por el mundo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He decided to abandon his job to travel the world.

cards.sentence: Necesito ajustar mi reloj antes de salir.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need to adjust my watch before leaving.

cards.sentence: Me encanta bailar en las fiestas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I love to dance at parties.

cards.sentence: El cuadro en la pared es una obra famosa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The painting on the wall is a famous piece.

cards.sentence: ¿Dónde vives actualmente?
cards.sentenceTranslation: Where do you live currently?

cards.sentence: Me gusta escuchar música mientras trabajo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to listen to music while I work.

cards.sentence: La flor en el jardín huele muy bien.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The flower in the garden smells wonderful.

cards.sentence: Mi gato es muy juguetón.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My cat is very playful.

cards.sentence: Voy a hacer la cena esta noche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I will make dinner tonight.

cards.sentence: La isla tiene playas hermosas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The island has beautiful beaches.

cards.sentence: Los niños están jugando en el parque.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The children are playing in the park.

cards.sentence: La luz del sol ilumina la habitación.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The sunlight illuminates the room.

cards.sentence: La mujer que está allí es mi hermana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The woman over there is my sister.

cards.sentence: La nieve cubre todo el paisaje.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The snow covers the entire landscape.

cards.sentence: ¿Puedes oír la música desde aquí?
cards.sentenceTranslation: Can you hear the music from here?

cards.sentence: Mi perro es muy leal.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My dog is very loyal.

cards.sentence: Vamos a quedar en el café a las cinco.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We are going to meet at the café at five.

cards.sentence: Voy a regresar a casa después del trabajo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I will return home after work.

cards.sentence: Debemos seguir adelante a pesar de las dificultades.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We must move forward despite the difficulties.

cards.sentence: Ella quiere trabajar en un hospital.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She wants to work in a hospital.

cards.sentence: No olvides usar tu abrigo hoy.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Don't forget to wear your coat today.

cards.sentence: Me encanta viajar a nuevas ciudades.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I love to travel to new cities.

cards.sentence: El zorro es conocido por su astucia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The fox is known for its cleverness.

cards.sentence: Voy a agregar más sal a la sopa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am going to add more salt to the soup.

cards.sentence: Necesito buscar mis llaves.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need to search for my keys.

cards.sentence: Me gusta caminar por la playa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to walk along the beach.

cards.sentence: Ella no puede decidir qué vestido usar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She can't decide what dress to wear.

cards.sentence: Espero encontrar a mis amigos en la fiesta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I hope to find my friends at the party.

cards.sentence: Es importante hacer ejercicio regularmente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It is important to exercise regularly.

cards.sentence: Voy a iniciar mi nuevo proyecto mañana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am going to start my new project tomorrow.

cards.sentence: Me gustaría leer un libro esta noche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I would like to read a book tonight.

cards.sentence: Voy a mirar una película esta noche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am going to watch a movie tonight.

cards.sentence: No noté que habías llegado.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I didn't notice you had arrived.

cards.sentence: Quiero ofrecerte mi ayuda.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I want to offer you my help.

cards.sentence: Voy a preguntar por la dirección.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am going to ask for directions.

cards.sentence: Nos podemos quedar aquí un rato más.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We can stay here for a while longer.

cards.sentence: Recuerda cerrar la puerta al salir.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Remember to close the door when you leave.

cards.sentence: Vamos a salir de casa a las seis.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We will leave the house at six.

cards.sentence: Voy a tomar un café antes de irme.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am going to have a coffee before I leave.

cards.sentence: Puedes usar mi coche si lo necesitas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: You can use my car if you need it.

cards.sentence: Quiero ver la nueva película que salió.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I want to see the new movie that came out.

cards.sentence: Espero vivir en una casa grande algún día.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I hope to live in a big house one day.

cards.sentence: La zanahoria es muy buena para la vista.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The carrot is very good for the eyesight.

cards.sentence: Es importante aumentar la inversión en educación.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It is important to increase the investment in education.

cards.sentence: Vamos a comer algo en el restaurante.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We are going to eat something at the restaurant.

cards.sentence: Necesito dormir más esta noche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need to sleep more tonight.

cards.sentence: Voy a enviar el paquete mañana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am going to send the package tomorrow.

cards.sentence: Ella es una persona muy feliz.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She is a very happy person.

cards.sentence: Es necesario generar nuevas ideas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It is necessary to generate new ideas.

cards.sentence: Me gusta hablar varios idiomas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to speak several languages.

cards.sentence: Voy a ir al cine esta noche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am going to the movies tonight.

cards.sentence: El jardín está lleno de flores.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The garden is full of flowers.

cards.sentence: La tienda está a cinco kilómetros de aquí.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The store is five kilometers from here.

cards.sentence: Me gusta visitar la librería los fines de semana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to visit the bookstore on weekends.

cards.sentence: La música me inspira a crear.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Music inspires me to create.

cards.sentence: La nube cubre el sol.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The cloud covers the sun.

cards.sentence: No sé qué va a ocurrir en el futuro.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I don't know what is going to happen in the future.

cards.sentence: Ella toca el piano muy bien.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She plays the piano very well.

cards.sentence: Quiero realizar un proyecto interesante este año.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I want to carry out an interesting project this year.

cards.sentence: No sé si tengo tiempo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I don't know if I have time.

cards.sentence: Tengo mucho trabajo que hacer hoy.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I have a lot of work to do today.

cards.sentence: Estudia en la universidad local.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He studies at the local university.

cards.sentence: Voy de vacaciones a la playa cada verano.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I go on vacation to the beach every summer.

cards.sentence: Me gusta el yogur de frutas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like fruit yogurt.

cards.sentence: Compré un nuevo par de zapatos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I bought a new pair of shoes.

cards.sentence: El dibujo que hiciste es muy bonito.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The drawing you did is very pretty.

cards.sentence: Necesito un lápiz para escribir.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need a pencil to write.

cards.sentence: El teléfono está sonando.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The telephone is ringing.

cards.sentence: Vivo en una casa pequeña.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I live in a small house.

cards.sentence: El auto está estacionado afuera.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The car is parked outside.

cards.sentence: La hoja del árbol se mueve con el viento.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The leaf of the tree moves with the wind.

cards.sentence: Se escuchaba un murmullo en la sala.
cards.sentenceTranslation: A murmur could be heard in the room.

cards.sentence: La tierra es muy fértil aquí.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The earth is very fertile here.

cards.sentence: La felicidad se encuentra en las pequeñas cosas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Happiness is found in the little things.

cards.sentence: La ciudad tiene muchos lugares de interés.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The city has many places of interest.

cards.sentence: El trabajo en equipo es esencial.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Teamwork is essential.

cards.sentence: El árbol da sombra en el verano.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The tree provides shade in the summer.

cards.sentence: La silla está hecha de madera.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The chair is made of wood.

cards.sentence: La salud es lo más importante en la vida.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Health is the most important thing in life.

cards.sentence: La actividad física es buena para el cuerpo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Physical activity is good for the body.

cards.sentence: Busco tranquilidad en la naturaleza.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I seek tranquility in nature.

cards.sentence: Su sonrisa ilumina el día.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Her smile brightens the day.

cards.sentence: El pueblo es conocido por su historia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The town is known for its history.

cards.sentence: El río fluye a través del valle.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The river flows through the valley.

cards.sentence: Nos gusta bailar en las fiestas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We like to dance at parties.

cards.sentence: El baño está al final del pasillo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The bathroom is at the end of the hallway.

cards.sentence: Me gusta charlar con mis amigos en el café.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to chat with my friends at the café.

cards.sentence: El grupo va a ensayar mañana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The group is going to rehearse tomorrow.

cards.sentence: La fábrica produce muchos productos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The factory produces many products.

cards.sentence: No hay necesidad de gritar, estoy aquí.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There's no need to shout, I'm here.

cards.sentence: La historia es fascinante y educativa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: History is fascinating and educational.

cards.sentence: Ese icóndito acabo de descubrirlo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: That hidden one I just discovered.

cards.sentence: El jardín era hermoso.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The garden was beautiful.

cards.sentence: El hotel está a cinco kilómetros de aquí.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The hotel is five kilometers from here.
